name: digitalocean
description: Manage a DigitalOcean cloud account through the official do-mcp server — Droplets, App Platform, managed databases, Kubernetes (DOKS), networking, storage, billing, and more, all behind one MCP connection.

interface.shortDescription: Manage every DigitalOcean product via the official do-mcp server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent becomes your DigitalOcean cloud operator — spinning up Droplets, managing databases, checking billing, deploying apps, and configuring networking. No more context-switching to the DigitalOcean control panel. Just tell your agent to resize a Droplet, run a backup, check your bill, or show you which databases need attention. Everything happens through conversation, with full access to your account.
defaultPrompt: Show me an overview of my DigitalOcean account — Droplets, databases, and current bill.
Help me resize my Droplet or create a new one.
Check if my managed database needs any maintenance or upgrades.
